quote: Yes, there is goal and meaning in our path - / but it’s the way that is the labour’s worth.
source: Karin Boye, In Motion, The Hearths (1927), lines 3 to 4 (trans. David McDuff, 1994)

evidence.where: The Karin Boye Society’s online edition of David McDuff’s translations, credited to Karin Boye: Complete Poems (Bloodaxe, 1994); page fetched this run
evidence.edition: Karin Boye: Complete Poems, trans. David McDuff (Bloodaxe Books, 1994)
evidence.locator: In Motion (I rörelse), from The Hearths (Härdarna, 1927), second couplet, lines 3 to 4

reason: The couplet stands as lines 3 to 4 of McDuff’s In Motion on the Karin Boye Society site, word for word as proposed, and matches the Swedish. The spaced hyphen after path is the Society’s setting and is kept as located; the printed book may set a dash there, which I could not see. Not shipped, not banned, Boye at 0.
